description: Create a Service Function Chain (steers traffic through inline SVR/LB hops to a final gateway). Only allowed in a Transit VPC. Use dryRun=true to preview the flattened request.

chainList.description: Ordered chain (1-5 hops); traffic passes chainList[0] → chainList[1] → ... All hops before the last must be SVR or LB; the last hop must NOT be SVR or LB (e.g. TRANSITVPCCONNECT, IGW, VGW, NATGW).

ingressNetworkInterfaceNo.description: Network interface number traffic enters through. Required when targetTypeCode=SVR

targetNo.description: Target instance number. Required for every type except IGW; must be omitted for IGW

targetTypeCode.description: Target type: SVR (server) | LB (load balancer) | TRANSITVPCCONNECT | IGW | VGW | POGW | NATGW | OGW

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the resource

serviceFunctionChainName.description: Name (3-30 chars; lowercase letters, digits, '-'; starts with a letter). Auto-assigned if omitted

name: ncloud_create_service_function_chain
